name: Sunken City | reference for multi-representation procedural game art

source.origin: User provided attachments (no third-party licensing audit)

workflow_for_existing_aka_roles.architect: Discover reference and prevent duplicate factory pipelines; preserve current world and priority.
workflow_for_existing_aka_roles.builder: Use donor techniques for one concrete graphics improvement in the current accepted game.
workflow_for_existing_aka_roles.fleet: Independently verify screenshots, animations, gameplay, performance and exact candidate SHA.
workflow_for_existing_aka_roles.ocean: Only integrate after protected CI and independent review; no direct push to master.
workflow_for_existing_aka_roles.sre: Watch loading size, FPS, regressions and unattended resource cost.

transfer_acceptance.visual_gate: Real playable before/after screenshots and normal-player observable change
transfer_acceptance.animation_gate: Matching clips and correct timings when animated improvement is claimed
transfer_acceptance.stability_gate: FPS and mobile viewport evidence; no degraded accepted game
transfer_acceptance.user_verdict: Only user may decide PASS or FAIL; log outcome learning after that verdict
